header.running_head: 3. The Rights and Duties of Muslims

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ سَلَمَةَ بْنِ اْلاَكْوَعِ ﵁ اَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ اُتِيَ بِجَنَازَةٍ لِيُصَلِّيَ عَلَيْهَا فَقَالَ: هَلْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ دَيْنٍ؟ فَقَالُوْا: لَا، فَصَلَّي عَلَيْهِ، ثُمّ اُتِيَ بِجَنَازَةٍ اُخْرَي فَقَالَ: هَلْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ دَيْنٍ؟ قَالُوْا: نَعَمْ، قَالَ: فَصَلُّوْا عَلَي صَاحِبِكُمْ، قَالَ اَبُوْ قَتَادَةَ: عَلَيَّ دَيْنُُهُ يَارَسُوْلَ اللهِ! فَصَلَّي عَلَيْهِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه البخاري باب من تكفل عن ميت ...رقم:٢٢٩٥
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Salamah ibn Akwa' (RA) says: “A janazah was brought to the Prophet ﷺ for him to lead the prayer over it. Rasulullah ﷺ asked: “Does this man who has died owe any debt?” The people said: “No.” The Prophet ﷺ led the prayer over that deceased man. Then another janazah was brought. Rasulullah ﷺ asked: “Does this man who has died owe any debt?” The Sahabah (RA) said: “Yes.” The Prophet ﷺ said to his companions: “You yourselves lead the janazah prayer over your friend.” Hazrat Abu Qatadah (RA) said: “O Rasulullah, I take on the responsibility of paying off his debt,” and the Prophet ﷺ then led the janazah prayer over him as well.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ اَبِيْ هُرَيْرَةَ ﵁ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: مَنْ اَخَذَ اَمْوَالَ النَّاسِ يُرِيْدُ اَدَاءَهَا اَدَّي اللهُ عَنْهُ، وَمَنْ اَخَذَ يُرِيْدُ اِتْلَافَهَا اَتْلَفَهُ اللهُ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه البخاري باب من اخذ اموال الناس... رقم:٢٣٨٧
blocks.tamil_translation: “Whoever takes money from people (as a loan) intending to pay it back, Allah Ta'ala will pay off the debt on his behalf. And whoever takes goods from people (as a loan) without intending to pay it back, Allah Ta'ala will ruin his wealth,” the Prophet
